name: 2D Gaussian Covariance Stabilization and Rescaling
definition: Computes the conic matrix (inverse covariance) and a rescale factor for a 2D Gaussian, applying a low-pass filter to ensure minimum pixel coverage.
summary: 2D Gaussian Covariance Stabilization and Rescaling reduces aliasing by smoothing covariance matrices and applying a rescale factor to preserve opacity, distinguishing itself through explicit anti-aliasing rather than mere numerical stabilization.
